notes.title: 2026-11-04 disclosure review: RELIANCE
notes.thesis_text: Source Summary, reviewed November 4, 2026. Historical model basis: 2026-03-31. The FY 2026 retail statements report 8,986,974,090 Reliance Retail ordinary shares entirely held by Reliance Retail Ventures. INR 38,226crore of Retail optionally fully convertible debentures are also held by Retail Ventures and are intragroup, not an additional external consolidated deduction. Retail Ventures has 7,011,242,660 issued ordinary shares, of which Reliance Industries holds 5,858,486,658. Preference capital in these statements is authorized rather than issued. This does not establish absence of every group award. Segment GST remains unallocated between external and intersegment sales, so mechanically subtracting it does not establish net external revenue by industry. notes.title: 2026-11-04 disclosure review: BHARTIARTL
notes.thesis_text: Source Summary, reviewed November 4, 2026. Historical model basis: 2026-03-31. At March 31, 2026 Airtel Africa reports 3,654,881,028 issued ordinary shares and 6,829,485 treasury shares. Indus reports 2,638,162,757 issued shares,1,352,208,904 held by Bharti Airtel and 972,953 held by its employee trust. These counts refine the ownership reconciliation but do not complete settlement or claim valuation. Nxtra standalone equity is INR 32,447m while the Bharti consolidated subsidiary note reports INR 32,393m; they are different scopes. Separate Money IPO-linked interests are outside the Africa ordinary award population. The September 23 AMC registration provides historical March 31 information, but its later ownership cannot be backdated. The put purchase cap means total investor holdings are not automatically the covered population. The exact put-covered share population and corresponding allocation within Bharti non-controlling interests remain unresolved. The approved additional INR 14,905.66m allowance remains a User Assumption. Africa treasury subpopulation disclosures do not fully reconcile; the stated total uses the reported Note 28 accounting balance. notes.title: 2026-11-04 disclosure review: SBIN
notes.thesis_text: Source Summary, reviewed November 4, 2026. Historical model basis: 2026-03-31. At March 31, 2026, subsidiary closing awards are SBI Life 3,094,990, SBI General 416,783, SBI Funds 11,922,312 and SBI Card 405,789. These are separate child-share populations, not SBI parent shares. Calculation: Funds exercises 3,183,008 reconcile to 2,123,601 newly issued shares plus 1,059,407 employee-trust transfers. Funds option counts already reflect the bonus adjustment. Intrinsic-value accounting and grant-date fair values do not establish a zero or current aggregate claim value. The closing Funds trust balance, future settlement mix, performance maxima and complete claim valuation remain unresolved. Reported disposal gains and the RRB charge remain in reported history. The newly retained Yes Bank report records 381,906,675 closing awards, comprising 345,826,675 non-RSU options and 36,080,000 RSUs. Calculation: its 25,641,735 exercises match the SBI parent report. These are Yes Bank primary-issuance awards of an equity-method associate, not SBI shares; the reported 10.78% holding does not convert grant-date accounting values into a current parent claim deduction. Review status: agent review under the user's delegated research authority; no independent human certification. No valuation inputs, forecasts or current-price comparisons were changed. notes.title: 2026-11-04 disclosure review: GOOG
notes.thesis_text: Source Summary, reviewed November 4, 2026. Historical model basis: 2025-12-31. The FY 2025 filing says Other Bets awards can be equity or liability classified; liability awards are remeasured through settlement using underlying equity value. The ending liability balance is not separately supplied. VIE assets of USD 5.6bn and nonrecourse liabilities of USD 2.0bn are not substitutes for that missing claim. Exhibit 21 lists three subsidiaries without ownership percentages. The approved USD 3bn claim reserve remains a User Assumption. The USD 3.4bn non-controlling-interest amount already includes USD 0.841bn redeemable interests. GOOG and GOOGL share one issuer value and must not be added together. This reserve is calibrated to an annual expense difference, with unquantified potential overlap with book non-controlling interests and forecast operating costs. Review status: agent review under the user's delegated research authority; no independent human certification. No valuation inputs, forecasts or current-price comparisons were changed.
